import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_transpose2D_kernel_(x, shape2D):
    P, F = x.shape
    F1, F2 = shape2D
    assert F1 * F2 == F, f"shape2D {shape2D} does not match the free size {F}"

    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray((P, F), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)

    # Allocate a tile for the data
    tile = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)

    # Copy data from HBM to SBUF tile
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x)

    # Reshape and transpose within the tile
    # Loop over the partition dimension
    for p in nl.affine_range(P):
        # Copy the row from HBM to tile
        nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x[p:p+1, :])

        # Reshape the tile to (F1, F2)
        tile_view = tile.reshape((F1, F2))

        # Transpose the tile
        transposed = tile_view.transpose()

        # Copy the transposed tile back to HBM
        nisa.dma_copy(dst=out[p:p+1, :], src=transposed)

    return out

    F1, F2 = shape2D
    assert F1 * F2 == F, f"shape2D {shape2D} does not match the free size {F}"

    out = nl.ndarray((P, F), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)

    tile = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)

    # Copy data from HBM to SBUF tile
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x)

    # Reshape and transpose within the tile
    # Extract the partition index and the two free dimensions
    # Loop over the partition dimension
    for p in nl.affine_range(P):

        tile[0:128, 0:128] = x[p, 0:128*F2].reshape(128, F2)

        # Transpose the 2D matrix within the tile
        # Use tile view to transpose
        transposed = tile.transpose(1, 0)

        # Store the transposed data back to HBM
        out[p, 0:128*F1] = transposed.reshape(128*F1)

    return out
